# BC Cycle Tourism Society

The BC Cycle Tourism Society (BCCTS) is a non-profit that supports cycle
tourism in British Columbia, Canada. Our website at bccycletourism.ca
publishes an extensive directory of cyclist-welcoming businesses in BC
with cyclist amenities, how-to articles on cycling in BC, route
suggestions, and field reports from real BC bike trips.

## Sections

- [Routes](https://bccycletourism.ca/routes/): 10 multi-day cycling routes
  across BC, with distance, surface, difficulty, communities, and
  RideWithGPS maps. Includes the Okanagan Rail Trail, KVR Myra Canyon,
  Sea to Sky Trail, Frog Peak Loop, Kettle Valley, and others.
- [We Welcome Cyclists](https://bccycletourism.ca/we-welcome-cyclists/):
  Business directory built for touring cyclists. Seven categories
  (accommodation, food & drink, bike services, groceries, transport,
  activities, info) with explicit accreditation criteria for each. Four
  tiers: Accredited, Welcoming, Info, and Bikes Unwelcome.
- [Field Notes](https://bccycletourism.ca/field-notes/): First-person
  articles from BC bike trips, plus a monthly Dispatch newsletter
  covering BC cycle tourism news, route updates, and infrastructure.
- [About](https://bccycletourism.ca/about/): Who we are, how we work,
  and how to get in touch.
- [Apply](https://bccycletourism.ca/apply/): Apply for We Welcome
  Cyclists accreditation.
- [Suggest](https://bccycletourism.ca/suggest/): Suggest a business
  for the directory.
